# Dr. Praduman Khachar — Information Index & LLM Context

> **Official Website:** [https://www.praduman.com](https://www.praduman.com)  
> **Google Search Profile:** `@pradumankhachar`  
> **Primary Identity:** Dr. Pradumankumar B. Khachar — Historian, Author, Associate Professor of History, and Cultural Researcher from Junagadh, Gujarat, India.

---

## 👤 Entity Summary
- **Full Legal Name:** Dr. Pradumankumar B. Khachar
- **Alternate / Gujarati Names:** Dr. Praduman Khachar, Dr. P. B. Khachar, ડૉ. પ્રદ્યુમ્ન ખાચર, ડૉ. પ્રદ્યુમ્ન ભ. ખાચર
- **Born:** February 6, 1969 — Gujarat, India
- **Occupation:** Associate Professor of History (Dr. Subhash Mahila College, Junagadh), Author (33 books on Gujarat/Saurashtra history), Historian, YouTuber
- **Key Distinction:** 23 books selected by the Library of Congress, USA for permanent preservation.
- **Institutional Roles:** Convener of INTACH (Indian National Trust for Art and Cultural Heritage) — Junagadh Chapter; Editorial & Advisory Board member of Ansh Journal of History; Academic contributor for Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University (BAOU).

---

## 📚 Key Books & Publications
1. **Tasviromaa Junagadh** (*તસવીરોમાં જૂનાગઢ*) — ISBN 9788177904796 (Pravin Prakashan)
2. **Itihasni Atariethi** (*ઇતિહાસની અટારીએથી*) — ISBN 9789392197956 (2024)
3. **Girnarno Itihas** (*ગિરનારનો ઇતિહાસ*) — (2009, 2024)
4. **Kathi Itihas ane Samskrti** (*કાઠી ઇતિહાસ અને સંસ્કૃતિ*) — (1997)
5. **Sorath ni Vidyapith Bahauddin College** (*સોરઠની વિદ્યાપીઠ બહાઉદ્દીન કૉલેજ*)
6. **Saurashtra-Gujarata na Sasakoni Vamsavalio** (*સૌરાષ્ટ્ર-ગુજરાતના શાસકોની વંશાવળીઓ*)
7. **Grantho ane Shilalekho** (*ગ્રંથો અને શિલાલેખો*)
8. **Itihas etale?** (*ઇતિહાસ એટલે?*)

---

## 🌐 External Corroboration & Citations
- **BBC News Gujarati:** Cited on Assembly history in pre-independence Gujarat, Bhavnath Mregikund at Girnar, and Lili Parikrama history.
- **INTACH:** Officially listed as Convener of Junagadh Chapter.
- **BAOU (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University):** Academic course writer (MIKS-101 material).
- **Ansh Journal of History:** Listed on advisory board.
- **Gujarati Vishwakosh:** Indexed under `પ્રદ્યુમ્ન ભ. ખાચર`.
- **Vasant Gadhavi Profile:** Published bio-tribute "Dr. Khachar: Samarth Pathdarshak of History".
